title: Run one RECOVERABLE_ONLY command-line backup to the enrolled NTC drive against the revalidated governed inventory

source.execution_instruction: Owner answer 'Authorize CLI backup' in this session to the question whether to run the RECOVERABLE_ONLY backup to the NTC drive through the command-line path, after FULL_RECOVERY was shown to be structurally blocked by the governed exclusions.

authorizes: writing one new encrypted Restic snapshot to the enrolled NTC repository with read-back, repository check and isolated restore
staging the capture and isolated restore under .local
explicitly_not_authorized: changing .env or the Admin backup policy, or restarting services
pruning, forgetting or deleting any snapshot, staging or drill directory
